provenance.encoding: The utf16le binding describes 16-bit little-endian game-text storage, not Unicode normalization. These strings retain newline code unit 000A and game-specific glyph values including 0085, 0092 and E000 exactly as stored. Every declared literal length includes its first 0000 terminator, with no earlier zero code unit. The asset slices preserve encoded payload bytes directly rather than recreating C byte arrays.
